title: Grindstone Prospecting
description: Transform gravel and sand into valuable resources using grindstones! Right-click grindstones while holding these materials to prospect for rare ores, gems, and metals. Features exciting particle effects and rare diamond discoveries with fireworks!
body:
⛏️ Turn Gravel & Sand into Treasures! ✨💎

Use grindstones to unlock hidden riches:

🪨 Right-click while holding gravel or sand

💎 Prospect for rare ores, gems, and metals

🎆 Enjoy dazzling particle effects and fireworks for diamond discoveries!

Transform ordinary materials into extraordinary loot and make mining magical! ⚡🔮

For support or inquiries, message me on discord:
procurer
